concepts.quote: the same code reads the keyboard, a file or a pipe
concepts.why: Correctly identifies a pipe as a source of standard input that the unchanged program reads, but says nothing about what the pipeline outputs or how the stream flows between the two programs.

concepts.quote: Average does not change at all; the same code reads the keyboard, a file or a pipe
concepts.why: States the correct rule that redirection leaves the program itself unchanged, but does not apply it to the commands (no terminal output, file contents, or args[] content given).
The answer says nothing about launching the program, main(), or what args[] contains when Average runs.
